title: quest overview undercounts tasks by omitting .quest/completed/ entirely
description:
Found in this repository while running a fleet-wide dedupe pass (OPAG-176), and independently corroborated by quest-web on its own tracker the same day -- two repositories, same shape, unrelated discovery paths.

MEASURED HERE against this repository live state: `quest overview --json` reports tasks.total 232 with byStatus {Done:201, Paused:2, To Do:29} (232 = 201+2+29 exactly). Direct file counts: .quest/tasks/ holds 232 files (which is why overview total matches it exactly -- it is scanning ONLY that directory), .quest/completed/ holds 94, .quest/archive/tasks/ holds 1. `quest task list --json` (no flags) returns 326 records; `--include-archived` returns 327. So overview undercounts the true total by 95 (327-232), and the byStatus Done figure (201) is itself wrong by the full 94-record gap -- the true Done count is 201+94=295, not 201. The 201-vs-actual-295 split exists only because this repositorys Backlog-migration importer placed historically-Done records directly into .quest/tasks/ without ever moving them via `task complete`; a workspace without that migration history would show the gap as a near-total miss on Done, the same shape quest-web found (their tasks/ held 29 open records only, completed/ held 24, and overview reported total:29 -- missing completed/ entirely rather than partially).

CORROBORATION, independently measured by quest-web on its own tracker same day: `quest overview` -> tasks.total 29; `quest task list` -> 53 records; .quest/tasks/ holds 29, .quest/completed/ holds 24, zero overlapping ids; task list correctly merges both, overview does not.

Also measured here as a useful negative control for a related open question: `--include-archived` DOES change this repositorys count (326 -> 327), so the flag is wired correctly here -- quest-web separately found zero difference on their own repo and could not tell whether that meant nothing was archived there or the flag does nothing; this repositorys result is evidence for the former reading (the flag works), not proof for their repo specifically.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest overview reads task counts from every location task list already merges (.quest/tasks/, .quest/completed/, and archived records when the equivalent of --include-archived applies), not only .quest/tasks/
A regression test asserts overview total matches task list count (with the same archived-inclusion semantics) on a fixture with records in both tasks/ and completed/
Verified against a real workspace with both directories populated (this repository qualifies), not only a synthetic fixture
